description: Land Acquisition - Welikada, Sri Jayawardanepura Kotte D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is a land acquisition notice under the Land Acquisition Act, declaring that specific land parcels are needed for a public purpose. It provides detailed descriptions of the land lots, including their extent, location, boundaries, and assessment numbers. The content is exclusively focused on land matters, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land acquisitions and property-related administrative actions.
